component.name: gcodekit5-design
component.summary: Universal G-Code Sender for Laser and CNC machines

description.p: GCodeKit5 Design is an enhanced fork of GCodeKit5. It includes a powerful Designer module with raster image support, mixed compositions, and independent per-object laser/CNC parameters (speed, power, and passes).
Based on the original Rust-based Universal G-Code Sender by Tim Hawkins, it supports GRBL, TinyG, g2core, Smoothieware, and FluidNC controllers.
